resources.string: Welcome to FXboard! It\'s FUTO Keyboard with keyboard effects added, made by an independent developer and still a work in progress. It isn\'t made or supported by FUTO.\n\nTo get started, enable FXboard as an input method.
Please select FXboard as your active input method.
New versions come out on FXboard\'s GitHub releases page. Obtainium can install them for you automatically.
